01 // Why Notation?

Everything you need.
Nothing you don't.

A real editor for real files, not another elaborate system for trapping your grocery lists in someone else's cloud.

⌨

Syntax highlighting

Read and edit code and everyday text with comfortable syntax highlighting across many text formats.

▣

AES-256 encryption

Protect sensitive notes with a password and AES-256 encryption. Some things are better kept private.

#

Custom tags

Add your own tags to notes for another layer of organization, beyond folders and filenames.

▤

Real files, real folders

Point Notation at a folder of text files. No proprietary notebook format or forced import process.

↔

Storage freedom

Keep and sync your files using locations supported in iPadOS Files or macOS Finder.

{ }

Free and open source

Made to be useful, not to upsell you. The code will be published on GitHub soon.

02 // Meet the editor

A little less clutter.
A lot more writing.

Dark by design. Cyan where it counts. Fast access to your folders, files, and tags, with your writing front and center.

NOTATION / EDITOR PREVIEWiPad + Mac
THE REAL APP. Not a made-up mockup.Shown on iPad • Interface may evolve
03 // Simple by design

Open folder.
Start writing.

No special setup rituals. Your existing files already have a home.

01.

Choose a folder

Select a folder from Files on iPad or Finder on Mac. Notation works with the text files you already own.

02.

Edit and organize

Write notes, work with code, and attach custom tags to keep things easy to find.

03.

Store it your way

Use local storage or a compatible storage provider. Your existing file storage and syncing workflow stays yours.

04 // The philosophy

Text files should stay text files.

Notation opens ordinary files in ordinary folders. Your editor shouldn't dictate your cloud provider, your operating system, or whether you can take your own work somewhere else.

NO SUBSCRIPTION.
NO LOCK-IN.
JUST YOUR FILES.
